title: Null control: Bandar Abbas temp vs UAL returns
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Bandar Abbas mean temperature 20d z-score > 1 is also a null for UAL returns (null control, 0 sign); trade long UAL 5d at 2d lag [weather.bandar_abbas.temp_mean -> finance.UAL.log_return] (parent: R2-0072)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.bandar_abbas.temp_mean rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long UAL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
